final: SELECT t.tradekind AS trader_type, COUNT(*) AS analysed_trade_records, COUNT(*) * 1.0 / SUM(COUNT(*)) OVER () AS share_of_total FROM advancedbehavior AS a JOIN transactionrecord AS r ON r.transreg = a.translink JOIN trader AS t ON t.tradereg = r.trdref GROUP BY t.tradekind ORDER BY t.tradekind
